character.topsis: TOPSIS measures the distance to the ideal and to the anti-ideal, so strengths can make up for a weakness.
character.saw: SAW adds up the weighted values, so strengths make up for a weakness fully.
character.vikor: VIKOR weighs the total against the single largest regret, so one big weakness weighs heavily.
character.edas: EDAS measures the distance above and below the average, so strengths can make up for a weakness.
character.waspas: WASPAS blends a sum with a product, so a very weak value counts more than in a plain sum.
character.copras: COPRAS adds up the benefit shares, and cost enters through the reciprocal of its total share, so a very low-cost alternative gets a big bonus.
character.marcos: MARCOS divides SAW's weighted total by two fixed numbers, so it orders exactly like SAW with the Linear option.
character.cocoso: CoCoSo adds up powers of the 0-1 values, so being exactly last on a criterion costs almost a full point.
character.mabac: MABAC adds up how far each 0-1 value lies above or below a border, so strengths make up for a weakness fully, as in a 0-1 weighted sum.
character.moora: MOORA adds the vector-normalized benefit ratios and subtracts the cost ratios, so strengths make up for a weakness linearly on the Euclidean scale.
character.aras: ARAS adds up the weighted column shares with the optimal row in the total, so strengths make up for a weakness fully.
character.codas: CODAS measures the Euclidean and Taxicab distances from the worst weighted value across every pair, so one large lead above the worst value boosts Euclidean distance more than several small ones.
character.promethee-ii: PROMETHEE II compares alternatives pair by pair through a preference function capped at 1, so how much a difference counts depends on the chosen preference curve.
character.electre-iii: ELECTRE III builds a fuzzy outranking credibility matrix using indifference, preference and veto thresholds, then distills descending and ascending pre-orders.
